paper: Goedel Machines: Self-Referential Universal Problem Solvers Making Provably Optimal Self-Improvements

expected_answer: A Gödel machine can rewrite any part of its own software after proving that the rewrite increases the specified utility, whereas traditional algorithms are hardwired and cannot theoretically improve themselves in an arbitrary, provably sound manner.

paper: Denoising autoencoder with modulated lateral connections learns invariant representations of natural images
question: What are the three denoising autoencoder architectures compared in the experiments, and what is the main motivation for introducing lateral connections?
expected_answer: The experiments compare a basic denoising autoencoder without lateral connections (No-lat), a model with additive lateral connections (Add), and a model with modulated lateral connections (Mod). Lateral connections are introduced so that detailed information can bypass higher layers, allowing the higher-level representations to focus on abstract invariant features.
